query: INSERT INTO series_sources (id, series_id, provider_id, source_path, provider_title) SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_path) id, series_id, $2, source_path, provider_title FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $3::uuid[], $4::text[], $5::text[]) AS t(id, series_id, source_path, provider_title) ON CONFLICT (provider_id, source_path) DO UPDATE SET provider_title = EXCLUDED.provider_title
